question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id, SUM(ds.points) as total_points
    FROM races r
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON r.race_id = ds.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, ds.driver_id
),
top_drivers AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, total_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC) as rn
    FROM driver_points
),
constructor_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM races r
    JOIN constructor_standings cs ON r.race_id = cs.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
top_constructors AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, total_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC) as rn
    FROM constructor_points
)
SELECT d.year,
       d.driver_id,
       d2.full_name,
       d.total_points as driver_points,
       c.constructor_id,
       c.total_points as constructor_points
FROM top_drivers d
JOIN drivers_ext d2 ON d.driver_id = d2.driver_id
JOIN top_constructors c ON d.year = c.year
WHERE d.rn = 1 AND c.rn = 1
ORDER BY d.year
